plan.goal: Thoroughly validate CodeKite’s primary pricing calculator flow, supporting plan/FAQ/comparison content, and adjacent navigation paths across desktop and mobile.
plan.summary: Start from the landing page to confirm the main conversion paths into pricing and docs, then spend most of the run on pricing.html where the interactive calculator, plan selection, monthly total, and recommendation logic live. After that, verify adjacent informational content on docs.html and return to pricing for deeper validation of the comparison table, FAQ accordion, and footer links. Repeat the critical pricing checks in a mobile viewport, with special attention to small tap targets and the calculator’s two-way linked controls.
assumptions: The pricing page is the primary product experience and contains the most meaningful interactive behavior in the site.
The three slider/number pairs on pricing.html are linked two-way and should stay synchronized when either control is changed.
The right-side sticky monthly total and recommended-plan badge update live based on calculator inputs.
Some footer and nav links are placeholders or external-style destinations and may not navigate to unique internal pages.
Mobile exploration should emphasize usability and control sizing rather than deep content variation, since only three HTML pages are known.
risk_hotspots: pricing.html calculator: three linked slider + number pairs for build minutes, concurrency, and storage
pricing.html add-on checkboxes for ARM / macOS / GPU runners and their effect on total cost
pricing.html sticky monthly total, recommended-plan badge, and line-item breakdown
pricing.html plan cards and CTA buttons: Free / Team / Enterprise actions
pricing.html 16-row comparison table and 10-question FAQ accordion
index.html and pricing.html small tap targets in header/footer on mobile
docs.html quickstart page: ensure the YAML example and nav links behave as expected

phases.title: Landing page entry and navigation
phases.objective: Validate the homepage messaging and the main routes into pricing and docs before focusing on the calculator.
key_checks: Confirm the hero CTA pair routes to pricing and docs as expected.
Verify top navigation links for Product, Pricing, Docs, Sign in, and Start free trial are present and usable.
Check whether the page has any broken or placeholder links beyond the visible marketing paths.
exit_criteria: Pricing and docs entry points have been exercised from the landing page.
No unexpected navigation failures or obvious broken primary CTAs are observed.

phases.title: Pricing page core calculator
phases.objective: Stress the primary pricing flow and confirm that editable controls, cost updates, and plan recommendations stay consistent.
key_checks: Interact with each slider and its paired number input to confirm two-way synchronization.
Test a few meaningful states for build minutes, concurrency, and storage, including low, mid, and high values.
Toggle ARM, macOS, and GPU runner checkboxes and verify their impact on the estimate and line items.
Observe whether the sticky monthly total and recommended-plan badge update correctly after each change.
Check for any formatting issues, stale totals, or mismatched labels in the cost breakdown.
exit_criteria: All three linked input pairs have been manipulated in both directions.
At least one changed state has been validated for each add-on checkbox.
The monthly total and recommended-plan behavior have been observed under multiple input combinations.

phases.title: Pricing plans, comparison, and FAQ
phases.objective: Validate the surrounding pricing content that supports purchase decisions and common questions.
key_checks: Open and inspect the plan cards for Free, Team, and Enterprise, including their CTAs.
Scan the 16-row comparison table for alignment, readability, and consistency with the plan cards.
Exercise several FAQ accordion items to confirm expand/collapse behavior and content clarity.
Check whether repeated CTAs such as Get started, Start trial, and Talk to sales feel consistent with plan positioning.
exit_criteria: Each plan card has been reviewed.
Multiple FAQ items have been expanded and collapsed successfully.
The comparison table has been visually checked for structure or overflow issues.

phases.title: Docs adjacency and back-navigation
phases.objective: Confirm the adjacent docs experience and ensure the site supports a reasonable informational detour from pricing.
key_checks: Verify the quickstart content loads and the YAML example is readable.
Check the header navigation back to Pricing and other top-level pages.
Confirm the docs page is consistent with the marketing site's tone and does not introduce broken states.
exit_criteria: Docs page content and navigation are verified.
Any path back to pricing has been exercised cleanly.

phases.title: Mobile viewport regression pass
phases.objective: Repeat the most important conversion and calculator checks on a mobile viewport, emphasizing touch usability and layout stability.
key_checks: Recheck header navigation and primary CTAs for tap usability on small screens.
Repeat core calculator interactions on pricing, including at least one slider/number pair and one checkbox toggle.
Verify the sticky total, plan cards, and FAQ remain usable without clipping or overlap.
Note any small tap target or spacing problems that hinder mobile use.
exit_criteria: Critical pricing interactions have been confirmed on mobile.
Mobile-specific layout or tap target issues have been documented where visible.

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all known HTML pages: index.html, pricing.html, and docs.html.
coverage_targets.features: Exercise the homepage CTAs, pricing calculator inputs, add-on checkboxes, plan CTAs, comparison table, FAQ accordion, docs quickstart content, and key header/footer navigation links.
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat the pricing calculator, main CTA, and one or two supporting navigation/content checks in a mobile viewport, with explicit attention to the small tap targets already flagged by prescan.

notes: Prescan already indicates no console or network errors; prioritize interaction/state validation and responsive usability over error hunting.
Several footer/social-style links on the landing page are placeholders (#), so treat them as likely non-navigational unless the run reveals otherwise.
Because the pricing page already shows missing input labels in prescan, pay special attention to accessibility and clarity around the calculator controls.
